a: US$10,000 plus one-year Optica student membership and mentoring
e: Twenty women students in optics and photonics are chosen each year for a merit- and need-based grant. Open internationally to undergraduates (optics, physics, chemistry, math or engineering majors with an interest in optics) and master's students in optics or photonics who self-identify as women.
